findings.title: Seven operations omit the mandatory owner character index
findings.reproducer: Valid open household owned by O, owner index hosted=[H], target member R with joined=[M], life index joined=[M], authenticated R; load leave for M with current household/member revisions. Loader returns only R character index.
findings.prediction: reduceConsent returns index_mismatch at its universal owner-index check, before the authorized operation.
findings.required: Load h.owner.character and target character exactly once for all seven operations; preserve index presence/absence and refusal behavior.

findings.title: Accepted-invitation read does not bind value.id to requested inviteId
findings.reproducer: Valid close view with member M pointing to I. tx.invite(I) returns present accepted invite J where J != I but membershipId=M, owner/recipient/home/household/epoch/permissions/answeredAt all match.
findings.prediction: linkedMemberInvites accepts the wrong-key row; close view and reducer patch can succeed.
findings.required: Require invite.id === member.inviteId in linkedMemberInvites. Preserve snapshot/read-set protection for this supporting read.

findings.title: Unused pair reads are fabricated as absent
findings.reproducer: Valid register or owner close; canonical pair exists, but no pairFact call occurs.
findings.prediction: Returned actor authority contains pair.state=absent despite no authoritative absence lookup.
findings.required: Use not-loaded for an intentionally unneeded pair; only an actual point lookup may establish absent.

findings.classification: boundary contract blocker for malformed/accessor-safe acceptance
findings.title: Unknown parser and point validation can invoke accessors or throw
findings.reproducer: rawCommand={get householdId(){throw Error('getter executed')}}; alternatively tx.home resolves {state:'present',value:{get id(){throw Error('row getter executed')}}}. A tx.home promise rejection also escapes.
findings.prediction: loadConsentView rejects its promise rather than producing a tagged failure; getter code executes. Nonthrowing getters and inherited fields can pass foundation structural guards.
findings.required: Define and enforce a bounded inert plain-data snapshot boundary before foundation validators, or make loader validation descriptor-safe. Reject accessors without invocation. Preserve transaction abort on read faults; never map faults/not-loaded to absent.
findings.distinction: No direct privilege escalation claimed for already-canonical JSON rows. Foundation guards were approved for canonical trusted views, not arbitrary accessor objects. Storage errors may intentionally throw if abort semantics are explicit.

authorityLimits: Actor is taken only from tx.sessionLife; exact authenticated session/slot/locator/life binding remains a trusted adapter obligation.
System authority comes only from tx.systemAuthority; typed objects do not mint authority. Internal jobs must prove current cause/subject/evidence in the transaction.
Final isView and reducer role/evidence checks remain mandatory; the weak kind-only Authority predicate at line114 is not a full authority parser.
Shared CharacterId/LifeId brands come from records.ts, also used by lifeIdentity.ts; brands validate UUID shape, not semantic authority.
nextFiniteAdapterRequirements: Correct/review the loader and remotely prove all eleven operations through loader plus reducer, not shape-only assertions.
One real store.transact binds authenticated exact life and home/epoch, current pair facts and internal system provenance; no body-supplied view or current-life fallback.
Keyed exact reads with real absence, snapshot/read-set validation including accepted-invitation supporting reads, no global scans, canonical inert row boundary.
Check every reducer expectation and all relevant supporting reads; commit writes, events/receipt and liability handoffs atomically or abort with no mutation.
Authorize minimal durable once-replay before new-intent loader, including closed households and ended memberships, with stable kind/fingerprint and actor/life checks.
Account park/archive/legacy move/erase and home replacement hooks preserve identity and close affected links before authority changes; no GET assignments.
Actual cloud Node/Worker durable reopen, rollback injection, races, malformed-row and boundedness evidence on pinned candidate; no local heavy checks.
